name: Solo Suite Enchance

scope.repository_boundary: AI tooling only; consuming application source, runtime configuration, deployment metadata, secrets, and product data remain in the consuming application repository

claude.validation: self-check, targeted tests, routing and parity validation

codex.validation: self-check, portable plugin validation, AgentRooms, routing and parity validation

notes: Platform folders are isolated copies of the validated native distributions.
Codex keeps its native skill and AgentRoom runtime rather than pretending to be a Claude command runtime.
Antigravity uses validated Claude-compatible capability trees with documented Google/Gemini config targets.
Generic application-delivery capabilities are instructions used on consuming projects; no application implementation is bundled here.
The 2026-08-25 repair update is included in the current mainline ancestry.
